title: World leaders head to Asia for back-to-back diplomatic summits
summary_full: Tussle for influence as trade, tech and regional security to take centre stage in China, Philippines and Cambodia meetingsWorld leaders will fly in to Asia for back-to-back high-level summits this week against the backdrop of the tussle for influence between the superpowers China and the US.Beijing will have the home advantage when it welcomes Donald Trump to its southern technology hub of Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leaders’ meeting. It starts two weeks after the US leader lost midterm elections. Continue reading...
